solutionStrategy: Infer a limited personality trait from the repeated action without adding facts beyond the sentence.
solutionSteps: Identify Tom's action: helping carry groceries.
Identify the person helped: his grandfather.
Notice every Saturday signals a regular routine.
Infer helpfulness, but do not invent unrelated traits.
Select A because it states both supported ideas.
